note: Small veteran-owned RV park inside Willow Springs, half a mile from Main Street and just off US 60/63, for self-contained RVs only. Premium sites sit under big sycamores; standard sites are meant for a night or two. The large building and pool area are off limits while the park is being worked on. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $36.50-41.50 (rates page modified 2025), 50A full hookups; sites 13 -> 18 (10 pull-through, 8 back-in, + 3 overflow), cleared the unsourced 32-ft max; added no showers/restrooms (self-contained only), phone/text/email booking. Passes price, presence and long-stay tests.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted nightly $36.50 standard / $41.50 premium (rates page, modified 2025-02-23) - under $50, no gateway needed. Presence: working operator website with phone (417) 349-5257; Google Maps 'The Campground at Willow Springs RV Park' 4.7 from 36 reviews, phone +1 417-349-5257, open; RV Life 4.0 from 43 reviews, $$ (avg $37). No Good Sam or other discount stated by the operator.

FIT: the operator posts no site length (only widths), and the stored 'max ~32 ft' was cleared as unsourced. RV Life reviews dated 2026 report motorhomes and fifth wheels in pull-through sites (6/2026 'Motorhome ... pull_through': 'adequate for a quick stop over'; 11/2026 'Motorhome ... pull_through': 'It's a cozy spot for an overnight'), and imagery shows ~20 m pull-through pads, so a 23-ft rig fits.

LONG-STAY: monthly sites 'limited' and only September-mid-May by application; nightly and weekly rates posted, standard sites 'intended for stays of just a night or two'; no lots or homes sold. RV Life 11/2026 reviewer: 'Most of the residents appeared to be long term.' Five tests read as passing (nightly posted, overnighters in every 2026 review). A 9/2026 RV Life reviewer reports paying $55 with Good Sam for a fifth wheel (no site type given) - an outlier against the posted $36.50/$41.50.
SELF-CONTAINED ONLY: no restrooms or showers on site (operator). Not a criteria failure for a 23-ft motorhome; recorded in facilities.
